name: Chthonic-Almagest
description: A shell of ancient ice seals the world, cracked into plates the size of nations and refrozen in place. Pressure ridges stack in turquoise ramparts, gleaming under a stingy sun near a nearby asteroid belt.
Standing still, you feel the cold air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
Mining charters include clauses about 'subsurface events' that lawyers refuse to define.
